Done. All 4 tests pass.

**What happened:** When order validation failed ("invalid order payload"), `processOrder.js` was acquiring a connection without try/finally, so if `run()` threw an error, the connection never got released. After 5 failed orders, the 5-slot pool was exhausted, causing cascading 503 errors and the page.

**Fix:** Use the `withConnection` helper (which wraps in try/finally) instead of manual acquire/release. Now connections are always returned to the pool, even on errors.
